T_k: The correction returns to the best-scoring iter-4 structure, a centred, even x4 term plus a steep saturating x2*x5 interaction, and drops the one-sided quadrant term that raised the loss. The x4 term is now damped more strongly by |x5|, so it fades faster when |x5| is large, where large-|x4| rows were still overpredicted, and stays nearly unchanged for small |x5|.
